options.name: -f
options.description: If the invoked shell is csh(1), this option prevents it from reading the .cshrc file

options.name: -l
options.description: Simulate a full login.  The environment is discarded except for  HOME, SHELL, PATH, TERM, and USER. HOME and SHELL are modified as above.

options.name: -m
options.description: Leave the environment unmodified.  The invoked shell is your login shell, and no directory changes are made.
